parsed.rationale: The eight members in this cluster span four unrelated packages (Playback, DebugPanel, Wallpaper, Intents) and represent entirely distinct domain concepts: IntentError in Intents/IntentUtilities.swift, PlaybackError/PlaybackState/PlayerState/StreamingAudioState in PlaybackCore and MP3Streamer, TimeoutError in a test file under MP3StreamerTests, and two independent ProcessInfo.ThermalState extensions in DebugPanel and Wallpaper. The structural signal is that all share an empty fields_or_signature list (shared_field_count=1), which is a trivially coincidental shape match — empty extensions or type-alias stubs are common across any codebase. There is no semantic relationship between, say, IntentError and StreamingAudioState that would justify consolidation, and the ProcessInfo.ThermalState duplication across DebugPanel and Wallpaper is the only pair worth a separate, targeted review. Merging these into a common abstraction would conflate unrelated concerns and violate package boundaries.
